name: ob1-vendored-tests

scripts.sync-auth: for d in _shared consolidation-workers/_shared ../recipes/editorial-policy/_shared; do cp ../server-portable/auth.ts "$d/auth.ts"; done

comment: Test-only, for the vendored recipe and integration servers (SMD-1252, FORK.md change 64; this directory since SMD-3747, which moved the suites and this install here from extensions/, where the extension servers lived until SMD-2311 made all six plugins). test-auth.ts imports the vendored recipes' and integrations' servers as deployed (change 67, SMD-1455); test-writes.ts (change 69, SMD-1228; change 71, SMD-1524) drives the vendored writers of a thought's content or vector against a real Postgres. hono and zod are one set across the tree's installs (this directory's, server-portable's, mcp-server's); the MCP packages split during the SDK v2 migration — server-portable is on the v2 scoped @modelcontextprotocol/core + @modelcontextprotocol/server (SMD-2278), while this install stays on the v1 @modelcontextprotocol/sdk + @hono/mcp (STACK in db/test-support.ts) — so test-auth.ts holds each install to its stack and fails on drift. Bump the shared packages across all of them in the same commit. Nothing vendored imports the MCP pair from this install since SMD-3747 retired the last MCP server's checks; it stays installed, at STACK's pins, for the next one, which first brings test-auth's MCP kind back. The integrations sit under this install; recipes/node_modules is a committed link to it, so a recipe run from a checkout resolves it too (SMD-1991). No types package: bun runs the test untyped, and nothing type-checks this directory. `bun run sync-auth` rewrites every _shared/auth.ts from server-portable/auth.ts; the test names the three and fails if one differs.
